turn.user_message: What happens after the 6 PM freeze?
turn.context: From bed-management.md §7.4.1: the 6 PM freeze, (d) beds held for emergencies, (e) call-in timing, Admission TAT under 30 minutes and admitted by about noon; Nagpur arrival and in-bed times.

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Automations, turn 6 (the record stops at 31)

text: After the freeze the engine keeps watch overnight. By morning everyone knows which bed frees when.
bullets: At 6 PM the plan freezes. Each patient coming in gets one bed and a call-in time.
Emergencies at night use the beds held back. The planned beds stay as they are.
In the morning, real discharge times come in. Patients arrive and finish paperwork before the bed frees.

blocks.condition: Today your patient arrives at 1 PM and is in bed at 4:30 PM. The goal is in bed by noon.

sheets.title: The plan is frozen
sheets.text: Tomorrow’s plan is fixed. Every planned patient has one bed. What is still without a bed is shared with everyone.

lines.label: Also makes
lines.value: The list still without a bed

sheets.entry: How many planned admissions do you take on a usual day?

sheets.title: Call-in times go out
sheets.text: Each patient is told when to come. The time is worked back from when their bed will be free.
sheets.entry: How do you reach planned patients today?

hand.does: Calls or messages each patient their time.

sheets.title: An emergency comes in
sheets.text: A number of beds is held back for emergencies, from two to three years of your own trend. The emergency takes one of those.
sheets.entry: How many emergencies come in on a usual night?

sheets.title: Morning discharges confirmed
sheets.text: Each discharge is confirmed on the morning round and logged as it happens. The engine checks the times against the plan.
sheets.entry: When do your first discharges usually happen?

hand.does: Confirms each discharge on the morning round.

sheets.title: Bills close, beds are cleaned
sheets.text: As bills close and beds are cleaned, each bed’s free time is checked against the call-in times.
sheets.entry: Who tells the desk a bed is cleaned?

sheets.title: Patients arrive and do paperwork
sheets.text: The patient comes before the bed is free. Paperwork is done while the bed is cleaned. In bed by noon, not 4:30 PM.
sheets.entry: Where do patients wait while paperwork is done?

hand.does: Finishes the paperwork while the bed is cleaned.

blocks.label: Admission time, the goal
blocks.sub: Today about 3½ hours, 1 hour of it paperwork. With call-in times, paperwork is the only step left.
